channel.title: The San Bernardino Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: China critic and former media tycoon Jimmy Lai is sentenced to 20 years in a Hong Kong security case
item.description: His daughter Claire says the sentence means he will “die a martyr behind bars."

item.title: Dodgers invite 32 non-roster players to spring training, including top prospects
item.description: Outfield prospects Josue DePaula, Zyhir Hope and Kendall George as well as pitchers Jackson Ferris, Adam Serwinowski and Nick Frasso are on the list.

item.title: Supporters of Riverside homeless project continue pressuring council to reconsider
item.description: With time running out, they don't stop calls for city to undo its rejection of $20.1 million grant to turn a University Avenue motel into housing.

item.title: Seahawks face challenges to repeat as Super Bowl champions
item.description: From coaching staff changes to potential free agency departures, Seattle has to avoid becoming complacent if it wants to join other NFL franchises that have won back-to-back titles.

item.title: Speedskating diva Jutta Leerdam delivers drama, celebrates gold medal
item.description: Leerdam delighted Dutch fans with an Olympic record in the women's 1,000 meters.

item.title: Victorville man awarded $27.3 million from deputy shooting that left him partially paralyzed
item.description: The jury award is believed to be highest ever in a nonfatal police shooting case out of Riverside federal court.

item.title: Lakers’ Kobe Bufkin is ‘excited to get to work’ as team’s new addition
item.description: Bufkin, who has averaged 27.7 points on 52.2% shooting for the South Bay Lakers in the NBA G-League, earned his chance to join the Lakers full-time, Coach JJ Redick says.

item.title: Man convicted of murder in 2022 carjacking and killing of a Riverside resident
item.description: A mistrial was declared for a co-defendant.

item.title: Ex-congregant links Inland Empire religious group’s ‘Prophetess’ leader to deaths in murder case
item.description: Kelli Byrd also testified that missing man Emilio Ghanem was afraid Shelley Martin would 'send someone after him' for opening a rival business.

item.title: Luka-less Lakers fall to Thunder, who win without Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description: LeBron James has 22 points and 10 assists and Austin Reaves scores 16 off the bench, but it’s not enough as the Lakers lose, 119-110, in a game between teams playing without their MVP candidates.
